title: Memory Model Fundamentals
intro: JROC implements SharedArrayBuffer and several Atomics operations, but full multi-agent shared-memory execution and ECMA-262 memory-model conformance remain unverified.

entries.notes: Growable SharedArrayBuffer, integer typed-array atomic operations, and Atomics.wait/waitAsync/notify are available. Native Test262 agents verify selected cross-agent notification and waiter behaviors, but full multi-agent memory-model conformance, including all ordering guarantees, is not yet verified.
